title: High Rollers members, Gallaty, Jack Laine and Frankie Christian
summary: He lists the players in the High Rollers, the leader Bill Gallaty, and the bands that followed: Jack Laine and Frankie Christian.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What instruments? What did they play?

They played guitar. One of them was Johnny Fernandez. The other one was Johnny Guitar. He played guitar. Bullwinkle. Wait, Bullwinkle. What did Bullwinkle play? I believe it was drums. That's a mistake. Let's not leave him out forever. Bullwinkle played drums. And Pete, wait a minute now. The Kornak player you're talking about? Pete Dentron. Yeah, I heard of him. You heard of him. Pete Dentron played trumpet. Gallaty used to play trombone, but Val trombone. And Parashe. Oh yeah, I know who you're talking about. We used to call him a different name.
He's a cousin of Pujol you're talking about. Pujol, that's right. Pujol. Pujol. Pujol.
You see, I'm starting to show too far back. I'm starting to show.
Well, your earliest recollections though, they were already white people playing jazz.

I know he went to a different name but Pujol. But his name was Palaszczuk. You see what I mean? Yeah. But we gave him the name of Pujol. I don't know how to call him, but that was it. Now, that was the men that really played in the high roles. Now, you had the...
Which one was the leader, Tink? Did you remember him? Bill Gallaty. Bill Gallaty.

Old man, not because he's got a son. We've got a Bill Gallaty plays now. Plays a trombone. Yeah, that's his son. Well, that's his son. He's worked with our band from time to time. Well, that's his son. Well, he's daddy. Because they used to own a dairy. He used to be a dairyman. He used to own a dairy. See? Well, that's all that I could think of. And then, following that was Jack Lane's band. And from Jack Lane's band was Frankie Christian, which I happened to play with them too. I played with Autumn. I kept on going, thank God.
